decisions.reason: WIN is a conventional compact race-result label; the source and current text match exactly and no embedded rule requires localization.
Cuộc đua Huyền thoại hằng ngày accurately renders 每日传奇比赛 and is natural Vietnamese; only target length is flagged.
The current wording is semantically understandable but awkward; this preserves the countdown/remaining sense of 距解锁还剩 in more natural compact Vietnamese.
Có thể mở khóa! faithfully preserves the positive availability message 可解锁！ with matching emphasis.
The current text uses the forbidden calque khai hoa tài năng. The embedded player-facing mechanic is Talent Bloom; the revised wording also fits a remaining-requirement counter naturally.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded community term system.talent_bloom.localize requires the exact accepted label Talent Bloom and forbids Khai hoa tài năng/Nở rộ tài năng.
